The '''Shasos sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The [[Bardotta system/Legends|Bardotta system]], which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bardotta/Legends|Bardotta]], was located in the system.<ref name="Nexus" />
